versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of the error-message-improver skill.
- Provides a structured workflow to help users create clearer error messages that explain failures, reasons, and next actions.
- Includes validation criteria, expected outputs, and reusable checklists or workflows for repeatable tasks.
- Designed for support teams, developers, and SaaS operators to improve troubleshooting productivity.
- Supports work-productivity, user feedback, and debugging use cases with local-hardware-friendly solutions.
